bug_report_content:
id: 791
status: Fixed
summary: Strange "wrong parameter" warning for callback function
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium']
stars: 0
commentCount: 2
Comment 0 (2012-08-03): What steps will reproduce the problem? Compile the followed code: /** @param {{func: function()}} obj */ function test1(obj) {}; var fnStruc1 = {}; fnStruc1.func = function() {}; test1(fnStruc1); What is the expected output? What do you see instead? Expected: compiled OK I see: WARNING - actual parameter 1 of func does not match formal parameter found : {func: function (): undefined} required: {func: function (): ?} func(fnStruc); ^ What version of the product are you using? On what operating system? r2102, Win7 x64 Please provide any additional information below. The followed code compiles OK: /** @param {{func: function()}} obj */ function test2(obj) {}; var fnStruc2 = { func: function() {} }; test2(fnStruc2); Discussion: https://groups.google.com/d/topic/closure-compiler-discuss/JuzERhGo48I/discussion
Comment 1 (2012-10-22): This issue was closed by revision r2265.
